I have resolved the issue in [related_descriptors.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-p62p6_44/django/db/models/fields/related_descriptors.py).

### Cause
When prefetching related objects via [`ForwardManyToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-p62p6_44/django/db/models/fields/related_descriptors.py#L120-L150), [`ReverseOneToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-p62p6_44/django/db/models/fields/related_descriptors.py#L365-L383), and [`RelatedManager.get_prefetch_queryset`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-p62p6_44/django/db/models/fields/related_descriptors.py#L635-L655), iterating over `queryset` evaluates nested prefetches (which populate the reverse relation cache on `rel_obj`), and then the loop unconditionally overwrote that cached related object on `rel_obj` with the parent `instance` from the outer queryset.

### Solution
Check `is_cached(rel_obj)` on the reverse relation field before setting the cached parent `instance` on `rel_obj` in `get_prefetch_queryset`.
